subject: Re: Kestrel status: CI green, fine-tune under way, one packaging trade-off
body:
Team,

Kestrel close-out decisions ahead of the May 15 review:

1. TF2-only paved path approved, exactly as Jorge framed it. TF1 layers stay in the package, documented as unsupported.
2. Umar's reproduction landed Apr 23: fine-tuning on the long-document dataset from the release matches the published setup within our eval tolerance, and the 4k-token runs on Cirrus came in 20% under the memory budget we'd assumed. That number goes in the adoption guide.
3. Adoption: three teams signed up at Thursday's demo. We onboard two in Q2 and hold the third for Q3 rather than stretch Tereza's support capacity - she's the only one covering example generation.

Santiago, please make sure the review doc is filed under the Kestrel program entry so leadership reporting picks it up.

Strong finish, everyone.

Dmitri
